title: CSCI 263 — Honors Introduction to Computer Science Theory
subject: Algorithms and Theory
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define and apply asymptotic notation to describe how resource usage scales with input size.
Explain how loop invariants support formal proofs of algorithm correctness through initialization, maintenance, and termination.
Identify and apply divide-and-conquer strategies to break complex problems into solvable subproblems.
